bullets: • Define exact property values; reject vague descriptions or assumptions about current state.
• Specify affected element and its before/after values; list unchanged related properties.
• Enumerate unrelated elements that must remain unchanged to prevent scope creep.
• Verify changes render correctly across page reloads without regression or artifact inconsistency.
• State testable observable outcomes; avoid implementation-specific or tool-dependent verification steps.
• Restrict changes to stated scope; reject modifications to unrelated properties or elements.
• Include dependent visual relationships; confirm balanced appearance with adjacent components.
• Name the file and code location where changes apply; ensure deployment consistency.
